# jupiterone_control (Data Source)

The current state of a single CCM control, including its evaluated compliance status. Managed control resources carry only declarative configuration, so evaluation results are read here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Managed control resources carry only declarative configuration. Evaluation
# results are read through data sources, so refreshing a control resource never
# churns on a status change.
data "jupiterone_control" "mfa" {
  id = jupiterone_control.mfa.id
}

# A control can also be looked up by its identifier in its source, which is how
# to reach controls that came from a catalog rather than from Terraform.
data "jupiterone_control" "from_catalog" {
  source_id = "cis-v8-5.3"
}

output "mfa_compliance" {
  value = {
    status = data.jupiterone_control.mfa.status

    # NO_TESTS means nothing is evaluating the control, which is a different
    # problem from the control failing.
    effectiveness = data.jupiterone_control.mfa.effective_status

    # Independent of status: a failing test is never masked by an attestation.
    attested = data.jupiterone_control.mfa.has_valid_attestation
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the control. Exactly one of id or source_id must be set.
- `source_id` (String) The identifier of the control in its source. Exactly one of id or source_id must be set.

### Read-Only

- `catalog` (String) The catalog the control belongs to, e.g. CIS Controls v8.
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the control is configured.
- `created_on` (String) When the control was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the control.
- `effective_status` (String) Whether the control is producing usable results: NO_TESTS, NO_DATAPOINTS or EFFECTIVE. NO_TESTS means no control test is defined; NO_DATAPOINTS means the tests returned no data.
- `exception_process` (String) Exception process in markdown format.
- `framework_ids` (List of String) The frameworks this control belongs to.
- `has_valid_attestation` (Boolean) Whether the control holds at least one valid, unexpired and unrevoked attestation. Independent of status: a failing control test is never masked by an attestation.
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the control, e.g. IDAM3.5.
- `last_evaluated_on` (String) When the control was last evaluated.
- `mitre_technique` (String) The MITRE ATT&CK technique ID this control relates to.
- `name` (String) The name of the control.
- `number_of_tests` (Number) How many control tests the control has.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the control, represented by a user email.
- `remediation` (String) Remediation steps in markdown format.
- `resource_group_id` (String) The resource group the control is scoped to.
- `source` (String) Where the control came from: J1, UCF, UPLOAD or JSON.
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state of the control: DRAFT, REVIEW, LIVE or RETIRED.
- `status` (String) The evaluated compliance status, PASS or FAIL. Only populated for LIVE controls. A control covered solely by a valid attestation reads as PASS; attestation coverage is reported separately by has_valid_attestation.
